# Antigravity Agent Guidelines (AGENTS.md)
> Engineering Specification and Multi-Model Subagent Orchestration Standard for Antigravity 2.0 and AI Coding Agents.

## Overview
- Title: Antigravity Agent Guidelines & Best Practices v1.0
- Author: Alphaxiaoteng
- Repository: https://github.com/Alphaxiaoteng/antigravity-agent-guidelines
- Compatibility: Google Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity CLI (agy), Codex, Gemini 3.7 Flash, GPT-5.6 Luna

## Model Routing Architecture
- Primary Scout: gemini-3.7-flash-tiered (medium thinking)
- Primary Builder: gemini-3.7-flash-tiered (high thinking)
- Independent Adversary Auditor: gpt-5.6-luna (max thinking)
- First Fallback Tier: gpt-5.6-luna (max thinking)
- Backup Tier: gpt-5.3-codex-spark (xhigh thinking)

## Key Disciplines
- First Principles: Product-first thinking (JTBD), Evidence over inference, Ponytail minimal changes.
- Anti-Hallucination: Three-state anchoring, Tool output windowing truncation, No placeholder destruction, Two-strike circuit breaker.
- Subagent Architecture: Coordinator thread (Sol), Executive Builders, Independent Red-Team reviewers.
- Harness Protocol: Prompt caching optimization, Process self-reclamation, 80-line rule guardrail.
